methods.name: groups.approve
methods.summary: Resolve one exact pending approval raised by a local or peer room member.

methods.name: groups.capabilities
methods.summary: Describe the hosted-room protocol implemented by this gateway.

methods.name: groups.create
methods.summary: Create a hosted room idempotently; authority is this gateway's stable install identity.

methods.name: groups.demote
methods.summary: Fence this gateway's stale room authority against a proven newer epoch.

methods.name: groups.disband
methods.summary: Permanently tombstone a hosted room id after stopping its work and revoking peer routes.

methods.name: groups.list
methods.summary: List rooms hosted by this gateway, most recently changed first.

methods.name: groups.log
methods.summary: A monotonic room-log delta after since_seq, bounded by count and page bytes.

methods.name: groups.peer.invite
methods.summary: Mint one target-issued room/profile grant for a prospective room home.

methods.name: groups.peer.register
methods.summary: Register and probe one scoped peer route on the room home.

methods.name: groups.peer.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke one target-issued grant using its exact profile scope.

methods.name: groups.promote
methods.summary: Continue a replicated room on this gateway at epoch + 1; requires confirm=true.

methods.name: groups.rename
methods.summary: Rename one hosted room atomically with its replay event.

methods.name: groups.replica_state
methods.summary: The local replica's coverage and authority lineage for one room.

methods.name: groups.replicate
methods.summary: Persist one authority-stamped replay page into the local replica store; idempotent.

methods.name: groups.retry
methods.summary: Retry one indeterminate room task after explicit user confirmation.

methods.name: groups.send
methods.summary: Append one inert message.user event idempotently; the actor is server-owned.

methods.name: groups.state
methods.summary: One hosted room's replay cursor and fenced authority state, plus live driver status.

methods.name: groups.stop
methods.summary: Durably cancel queued or running work for one hosted room.

methods.name: groups.attachment.download
methods.summary: Read one committed attachment for a live room viewer.

methods.name: groups.attachment.upload
methods.summary: Store one attachment for a later groups.send manifest (idempotent per upload_id).

methods.name: groups.discard
methods.summary: Discard one indeterminate room task after explicit user confirmation.

Room.description:
``gateway/hosted_rooms.py::_room_from_row`` plus the branch-only keys ``create`` (legacy
adoption), ``state`` (``authority_claim``) and ``rename`` (``event``) add.
Room.title: Room

RoomMember.description:
One roster row (``hosted_room_discussion.validate_roster``); legacy rooms may carry
pre-normalisation rows, so the set stays open.
RoomMember.title: RoomMember

RoomMemberInput.description: A roster row as the client proposes it; ``validate_roster`` owns the exact rules.
RoomMemberInput.title: RoomMemberInput

GroupsApproveResult.description: ``result`` is the local ``approval.respond`` answer or the peer's run-action receipt.
GroupsApproveResult.title: GroupsApproveResult

RoomDriverStatus.description:
``HostedRoomService.status(room_id)``; ``pending_actions`` rows are ``{kind: retry, task_id}``
or the driver's approval action (``kind: approval`` + run/session/approval context).
RoomDriverStatus.title: RoomDriverStatus
